note: Zoo Boo, Kiddo-Ween and a free Bomba y Plena festival on the Beach.

picks.reason: Zoo Boo at Zoo Miami — costumed animals and candy stations, the county's biggest Halloween event.
Kiddo-Ween Festival at Coral Gables Museum — free-ish family Halloween with crafts and performances.
3rd Festival de Bomba y Plena at the Bandshell — free Puerto Rican music and dance on the Beach.
Marci Poppin's Halloween Adventure at Doral Branch — free magic and storytelling.
Lincoln Road Farmer's Market — free Sunday stroll with produce, food stalls and people-watching.
